<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get the latest labor plan Workforce Management reported for a path"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/labor-plan-view"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the `LaborPlanObserved` read model — the latest `planned_heads`/`planned_rate`/`planned_hours` Workforce Management published on its `ShiftPlanCommitted` integration event for this path, projected via the Kafka consumer (Task 7). This is a read-only projection from a DIFFERENT bounded context's `ShiftPlan` concept — it is never fed into this service's own `PathPlan`/`ShiftPlan` aggregate or `CommitShiftPlan` use case. `404` until at least one `ShiftPlanCommitted` event has been observed for the path.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"pathId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The process path's identifier — a named station that owns a queue (unit-in → unit-out), e.g. a pick zone or pack line. Must belong to a process-path family declared in this deployment's process-path catalogue (ADR-0012; today the fleet's sortable-fc topology declares the pick/pack/rebin/slam families, each optionally carrying a \"-\"-delimited station/zone suffix, e.g. pick-a or pack-station-1). The write endpoints (receiveChargeForecast, commitShiftPlan, enqueueWorkUnit) reject ids outside the declared families with `400 unknown-path-id`; read endpoints surface a missing pool/projection as `404` instead.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"pattern":"^(pick|pack|rebin|slam)(-.*)?$"},"example":"pick-a"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
